content.value: Starting with the definition of radioactivity and the law of radioactive (15) disintegration. Show that for a successive radioactive disintegration, the amount of doughter substance at instance t is given by

$$
N _ { 2 } = \frac { \lambda _ { 1 } N _ { 1 } ^ { 0 } } { \lambda _ { 2 } - \lambda _ { 1 } } [ e ^ { - \lambda _ { 1 } t } - e ^ { - \lambda _ { 2 } t } ] .
$$
